The pathfinder gives up after 14 legs — it's trying to move but every leg is blocked. The earlier error explicitly said "in the way: Notice Board at (2,7)".

Let me try a fundamentally different idea: maybe the notice board is a *panel* and I should press E to open it, and the panel is at my tile so E should work but reports the tile I'm facing. What if I face the board by... the board is at my tile, so no facing works.

Let me try pressing E immediately after a fresh observe without any movement, in case facing defaults to the board.

Actually, let me reconsider the possibility that the game considers me NOT on the board, and the board is at (2,7) while I'm at (2,7) is a coincidence of the observe rounding. What if I'm at (2.5, 7) and the board at (2,7)? Then facing left (toward 2,7) and pressing E should read it. Let me face left and press E.

Already did — "nothing at 1,7".

Let me try pressing E while facing right toward the player, then check if maybe the player is the notice board... no.

Let me try a completely fresh tactic: maybe the game has a "stuck" recovery if I press E on the notice board from the tile I'm on by facing it — but I can't.

Wait, let me re-examine: maybe the map renderer is showing a DIFFERENT layer. The 'o' at (7,6) is the Gold Door, 'o' at (10,5) is the Workbench. The notice board at (2,7) is NOT shown as 'o' — maybe because I'm standing on it and '@' overrides. So the board IS at (2,7) and I'm on it.

Let me try: what if I press E and the game reads the notice board because it's under me? It reported "nothing at 1,7" (facing left). What if I face down/up/right and press E — all report the adjacent tile. None report the board.
